name: kubeclaude
description: Web UI that schedules and runs Claude Code prompts inside Kubernetes

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web && npm run typecheck --workspace e2e
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
